title: Arni Lemonato
subtitle: Greek braised lamb with lemon and herbs
excerpt: Lamb shoulder slowly braised with lemon, garlic, rosemary and white wine until the meat falls apart. The sauce is sharp and fragrant. Serve with bread to mop up every drop.
sourceNotes: Classic Greek braised lamb. Lemonato simply means lemon-braised and the technique is common across the country.

recipe.freezeNotes: Cool the lamb completely and freeze in the braising liquid. Defrost overnight in the fridge and reheat gently on the hob.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Cook the day before and reheat gently. The flavour deepens overnight.

content.text: Arni lemonato is slow-braised lamb lifted with lemon and rosemary. The meat becomes very tender. Keep the lid on for most of the cook so the liquid doesn't reduce too fast.

items.prepNote: juice of both, zest of one

content.text: Heat the oven to 170C. Season the lamb chunks well with salt and pepper.
Warm the olive oil in the dutch oven over a high heat. Brown the lamb in batches. Set the browned pieces aside.
Reduce the heat to medium. Cook the onion and garlic in the same pot for 5 minutes until softened.
Return the lamb to the pot. Add the lemon juice, lemon zest, rosemary, wine and stock.
Bring to a simmer. Cover with the lid and transfer to the oven.
Braise for 1 hour 45 minutes. Check halfway and add a splash of water if the liquid looks low.
Remove the lid and cook for 15 more minutes to concentrate the sauce. Rest for 10 minutes and scatter over the parsley to serve.

items.symptom: The lamb is still tough after 2 hours.
items.cause: The braise temperature was too low or the pieces were too large.
items.fix: Return to the oven for another 30 minutes. Lamb shoulder becomes tender with time, not pressure.

items.cause: Lemon pith got into the pot along with the juice.
items.fix: Add a pinch of sugar and a splash more stock. Zest carefully next time to avoid the white pith.

items.symptom: The liquid dried out during cooking.
items.cause: The lid was not on tight or the oven was too hot.
items.fix: Add 100 ml of hot water and replace the lid. Reduce the oven by 10 degrees for the remainder of the cook.
